columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Queued-work admission moves from persistence time to execution acceptance
columns.title_zh: 排队工作接纳从持久化时点前移到执行接受时点
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260812-G-001. It isolates a precise Digital Employee runtime question: when queued user work becomes admitted and therefore removable from the queue. The change moves admission to Core acceptance even when a later prompt hook can stop the turn, exposing a concrete boundary among intent receipt, execution authority, persistence and retry semantics. Skill 02 score: 47/50. The mechanism is directly testable and strongly relevant to worker inboxes, responsibility transfer and lost/duplicate-work prevention.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260812-G-001。它形成一个精确的数字员工运行问题：排队的用户工作在什么时点算作已接纳、从而可以从队列删除。该变更把接纳时点前移到 Core 接受，即使后续 Prompt Hook 仍可能终止 Turn，由此显式暴露意图接收、执行权、持久化与重试语义之间的边界。Skill 02 评分 47/50，可直接验证，并高度相关于 Worker Inbox、责任转移以及重复/丢失工作防护。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the exact admission transition, queue-entry deletion timing, new-turn versus steer behavior, prompt-hook failure boundary, persistence behavior after acceptance, and what retry or recovery guarantees are and are not implemented. Do not infer exactly-once semantics beyond the changed path.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查具体 Admission 转换、Queue Entry 删除时机、New Turn 与 Steer 行为、Prompt Hook 失败边界、接纳后的持久化行为，以及实现中实际存在或不存在的重试/恢复保证；不得把该路径扩大解释为全系统 Exactly-once。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Agent approval architecture separates one-session consent from persistent policy amendment
columns.title_zh: Agent 审批架构将单会话同意与持久策略修订分离
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260812-G-003. It provides a bounded governance-architecture object rather than a broad permissions topic: MCP approvals are normalized onto a shared ReviewDecision contract while a distinct ApprovedMcpPolicyAmendment can persist policy beyond a session. Skill 02 score: 46/50. The design exposes how temporary consent, durable policy, rejection, timeout and cancellation can share one decision surface without allowing domain-specific decisions to leak into unrelated approval paths.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260812-G-003。它不是泛化的权限话题，而是一个有界的治理架构对象：MCP 审批统一到共享 ReviewDecision 合同，同时通过独立的 ApprovedMcpPolicyAmendment 把策略变更持久到会话之外。Skill 02 评分 46/50。该设计清楚展示临时同意、持久策略、拒绝、超时与取消如何共享一个决策面，同时阻止领域专用决策泄漏到无关审批路径。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the ReviewDecision variants, how persistent MCP policy amendments are represented and applied, session-only approval boundaries, rejection/timeout/cancellation behavior, and guards that reject MCP-only decisions in non-MCP approval paths. Keep implementation facts distinct from broader governance implications.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查 ReviewDecision 变体、持久 MCP Policy Amendment 的表示与应用方式、仅会话审批边界、拒绝/超时/取消行为，以及阻止 MCP 专用决策进入非 MCP 审批路径的 Guard；实现事实与更广泛治理含义必须分开。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Nested callback runtimes need explicit ownership, cancellation and session isolation
columns.title_zh: 嵌套回调运行时需要显式所有权、取消与会话隔离
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260812-G-004. It is the strongest bounded engineering object in today's pool for nested agent/tool execution: callback ownership is explicit, cancellation is propagated, result and error sizes are bounded, cell/tool ownership is validated, and independent sessions are not unnecessarily serialized. Skill 02 score: 48/50. These mechanisms are implementation-level, regression-testable and directly relevant to safe concurrent tool runtimes.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260812-G-004。它是今日信号池中关于嵌套 Agent/Tool 执行最强的有界工程对象：Callback 所有权被显式定义、取消可传播、结果与错误大小受限、Cell/Tool 所有权被校验，同时独立 Session 不被无谓串行化。Skill 02 评分 48/50。这些机制属于实现层、可通过回归测试验证，并直接关系安全的并发工具运行时。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify callback ownership and routing, cancellation paths, result/error limits, cell and enabled-tool validation, concurrency isolation between sessions, cleanup behavior and the tests that define these boundaries. Do not generalize beyond the gRPC code-mode path without evidence.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查 Callback 所有权与路由、取消路径、结果/错误上限、Cell 与 Enabled Tool 校验、Session 间并发隔离、清理行为及定义这些边界的测试；没有证据时不得扩大到 gRPC Code Mode 之外。
